notes.title: Name change, Teaser and Store Page update
notes.notes:
Greetings Knights!

We are happy to announce few things.

[olist]
The name of the game has changed. It's Knights & Outlaws now. During the production, we have decided to move towards the adventure and story-driven style of the game. Simulator mechanics will still be present, but we feel like Knight Simulator's name doesn't fit anymore.

We have a new logo and graphics as well:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/6e3fa0d4de04902e32decb429c4aaa73f9a88d39.jpg

We made a game teaser ːsteamhappyː One can find it on our Steam page and our publisher Youtube:
[previewyoutube=u4wlTX6g_bo;full][/previewyoutube]

Our Steam store page has been updated with new screenshots, descriptions and gifs. It is now closer to what we want to achieve with our game.
[/olist]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122230/Knights__Outlaws/

More content in future Devlogs. Feedback is welcome, so leave a comment or join us on Discord Server!
Yours - Hydragon Knight Simulator Team
